parameters.stillness: fixed scale of distance to major roads; not measured noise

population.scope: All nonzero walkable OSM node-pair segments whose projected midpoint is covered by an official NYC borough polygon.
population.weight: Full projected segment length; separate overlapping mapped ways remain separate.
population.quantile: First sorted positive raw value whose cumulative segment length reaches 95% of positive total length; no interpolation.
population.normalization: clip(raw / upper, 0, 1); no per-window refitting; openness unchanged.

provenance.tree_status_policy: Include status=Alive in the 2015 census only. This does not assert survival today, canopy size, shade, or park-tree completeness.
provenance.poi_policy: Saved OSM scores plus conservative DOHMH additions, excluding high-confidence existing identity matches with a latest official closure action pending review. Source archives remain intact. Crossmatched identities are not double-counted. Ambiguous, closed, restricted or insufficiently documented additions remain review candidates. No inspection grade is used as experience quality.

limitations: 95th-percentile clipping is a versioned product-design choice, not a learned optimum or experience validation.
The stillness transform changes from local percentile rank to capped linear distance; the distance remains a proxy, not measured noise.
Length weighting reduces segment-count bias; midpoint measurements are not invariant to arbitrary segmentation.
Zero means no qualifying records in the saved layers, not verified absence in the city.
Tree and POI coverage varies by borough; fixed scaling does not correct missing or historical source data.
Midpoints outside NYC are excluded from fitting. Whole retained ways outside source context may have incomplete surroundings.
This reference does not normalize graph-dependent linearity or waterfront network distances, which are not active route-cost components.

open.measurement: 8-ray horizontal distance to official building boundaries, capped at 200 m
sources: NYC OTI Building Footprints; snapshot retrieved 2026-10-13
limitations: Measured from mapped geometry, not field-rated openness; no sky view or building-height model.

green.measurement: Count of records classified Alive in the 2015 Street Tree Census within 50 m
sources: NYC DPR 2015 Street Tree Census; Alive only
limitations: Historical alive status, not current survival, canopy, shade, or all park trees.
No measured sound, crowd levels, construction or time-of-day observations.

social.measurement: Sum of category-based social components within 100 m
sources: NYC DOHMH administrative records retrieved 2026-10-13; per-record inspection dates vary
limitations: Only food venue records are crosschecked. No measured social atmosphere or current occupancy.
An unmatched official record is not proof that no OSM duplicate exists.

access.measurement: Sum of category-based amenity components within 100 m
sources: NYC DOHMH administrative records retrieved 2026-10-13; per-record inspection dates vary
limitations: Amenity proximity, not wheelchair access, verified entrances, or live opening hours.
Only the food venue subset has an additional official source.

normalization.comparison_condition: same calibration reference, source snapshot, and measurement radii
